connects_to.relationship: strategic long-term supply agreement for indium phosphide substrates

contracts.signal: On July 26, 2026 AXT and Lumentum Operations LLC entered a Capacity Reservation Agreement for the supply and capacity reservation of indium phosphide wafer substrates: AXT reserves a minimum annual commitment of the products for Lumentum for a six-year period (the press release says through December 31, 2031) and will support additional capacity if required. Lumentum pays an initial deposit of $43,500,000 within thirty business days and a second deposit of $43,500,000 with timing and terms to be determined during calendar year 2028; the deposits are applied as shipment credits, and Lumentum is responsible for any shortfall below its annual purchase commitment.
